elements.el: Transcript entries for every kind: user, assistant, tool call, tool result, steer, compaction, note, restart, skipped and end.
Each entry has its time on the right and a kind label with an icon on the left. Arguments and results fold. A truncated entry says so. In fork mode, each entry offers Fork from here.
elements.reason: #747 excludes point-in-time forking (#648), Watch (#735), and exact sample fixture text and marker timestamps. Production uses real records and catalog words; the card’s sample values are not runtime contracts.
